messages:
irene: Heads up — GPU capacity looks available in us-east1 but our `gpu_utilization` metric has been flatlined since ~03:12 UTC, autoscaler didn't pick up demand.

dinesh: I see blank panels on the GPU dashboard and Prometheus target status shows `500` for several gpu-exporter endpoints.

alex: Any recent changes to exporters or metrics-aggregation? :eyes:

sunil: I rolled node-exporter v2.4.1 at 02:58 to patch a CVE. Reverting now to v2.4.0 while we triage.

ops-bot: [alert] job="gpu-exporter" target="10.12.5.9:9100" scrape_timeout exceeded (x6)

sre-oncall: I'm on it — tailing ingest-proxy and exporter logs, attaching snippets shortly.

dinesh: quick look: ingest-proxy logs show `recv buffer timeout` and several samples dropped. Might be increased scrape latency from exporter change.

alex: Can we add a short-term autoscaler fallback to use `kube_node_gpus_total` (node-reported GPU count) until metrics are healthy? Safer than leaving HPA blind.

sunil: That metric is queriable via kube-state-metrics. We can flip scaler config to include a fallback metric with priority. I'll prepare a small config patch.

irene: I've opened a config PR (PR #2897) that adds `fallback_metric: kube_node_gpus_total` and a 30s grace window for missing samples.

ops-bot: deploy started: revert/node-exporter v2.4.1 -> v2.4.0 @ 04:02 UTC (rolling 3 pods)

dinesh: After revert exporters returned 200s and sample rates recovered around 04:05. Prometheus scrape rate went from ~0.2sps back to ~8sps for gpu-exporter targets.

alex: Sample of the exporter error we saw earlier:
```
http: panic serving 10.12.5.9:2123: runtime error: invalid memory address
goroutine 42 [running]:
  .../exporter/collector.go:198 +0x1a3
```

sre-oncall: Autoscaler saw metrics back at 04:06 and triggered scale +12 GPUs. No region failover was needed — traffic stayed in us-east1.

irene: Moving forward we need: 1) exporter canary (small rollout with synthetic scrape checks), 2) synthetic probes/alert on scrape success rate, 3) telemetry-ingest fallback aggregator.

sunil: Created TICKET-512 for synthetic probe + alert rules. Added canary rollout plan to the ticket.

dinesh: Also opened PR #2901 to add a fallback aggregator in ingest-proxy that will emit `kube_node_gpus_total` as a synthetic metric when `gpu_utilization` drops for >15s.

alex: Postmortem note: root cause appears to be a non-critical binary change in node-exporter that increased tail-latency for /metrics under our exporter scrape pattern. We need canary + load test for exporter.

irene: Actions and owners: revert deploy (done), config fallback PR (#2897) in review — irene, fallback aggregator PR (#2901) — dinesh, synthetic probe + canary — sunil, postmortem writeup — alex.

sunil: Monitoring now stable, will watch for 1h and then close. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: incident/1839001234 status=resolved resolved_by=@sunil resolved_at=04:18 UTC
